text: 沪指午后跌超2%，深成指跌超2.5%，创业板指跌超3%。煤炭、油气开采及服务、港口航运板块跌幅居前。全市场超5000只个股下跌。
text_en: The Shanghai Composite Index fell more than 2% in the afternoon, the Shenzhen Component Index fell more than 2.5%, and the ChiNext Index fell more than 3%. Coal, oil and gas extraction and services, and port shipping sectors led the declines. More than 5,000 stocks fell across the market.
